verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs describe online scoring that evaluates production traces automatically as they are logged, running asynchronously with no latency impact. Its scorers can run against either datasets (experiments) or production traces, and instrumentation captures every request, so evaluators can run continuously on live traffic rather than only offline. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of online-scoring configuration (sampling rates, filters, alerting on live scores) and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works in production.
